run_generate_passage_embeddings: run the script to generate passage embeddings from a TSV file using a Contriever model
embed_passages_batch: embed a list of passages into dense vectors using a pretrained Contriever model and tokenizer
load_passages_and_embed: load passages from a TSV file and generate embeddings with optional title concatenation and text normalization
shard_passage_embedding: split passage embedding work across multiple shards for distributed processing on a large corpus
save_embeddings_pickle: save passage IDs and their corresponding embeddings to a pickle file in the output directory
